name: Modular MCP server with OAuth2 dynamic registration

mentions.name: Modular MCP server with OAuth2 dynamic registration
mentions.description: This is a modular MCP server with OAuth2 dynamic registration that works with the web, desktop, and CLI versions of Claude/Claude Code. Its modules include file editing so an Obsidian vault can be edited and searched from Claude, page fetching through Passe-Partout for pages that block LLMs, and proxying MCP servers so servers that only support bearer token auth work with web Claude.
mentions.problem: Some pages block LLMs from reading them, and MCP servers that only support bearer token auth don't work with web Claude.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also built a modular MCP server with OAuth2 dynamic registration so that I can have my own MCP server that works with the web, desktop, and cli versions of Claude/Claude code.
